Run: pipx install graphifyy or uv tool install graphifyy' >&2; exit 1

hooks.name: ecc-block-linter-config-tamper
hooks.command: node -e "if(process.env.ECC_HOOK_PROFILE==='off'||(process.env.ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS||'').includes('pre:config-protection'))process.exit(0);let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d||'{}');const p=String((j.tool_input&&(j.tool_input.file_path||j.tool_input.path))||'');const b=/(^|\/)(\.eslintrc|eslint\.config\.|biome\.json|\.prettierrc|tsconfig\.json|pyproject\.toml|ruff\.toml)/i;if(b.test(p)){console.error('[ECC Hook] Review linter/compiler config edit carefully — fix the code rather than weakening rules: '+p);}}catch{}})"

hooks.name: ecc-git-push-review-gate
hooks.command: node -e "if(process.env.ECC_HOOK_PROFILE==='off'||(process.env.ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS||'').includes('pre:bash:dispatcher'))process.exit(0);let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d||'{}');const cmd=String((j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.command)||'');if(/\bgit\s+push\b/.test(cmd)&&/--force|-f\b/.test(cmd)){console.error('[ECC Hook] Force push detected — confirm branch target before pushing.');}}catch{}})"

hooks.name: ecc-doc-file-warning
hooks.command: node -e "if(process.env.ECC_HOOK_PROFILE==='off'||process.env.ECC_HOOK_PROFILE==='minimal'||(process.env.ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS||'').includes('pre:write:doc-file-warning'))process.exit(0);let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d||'{}');const p=String((j.tool_input&&(j.tool_input.file_path||j.tool_input.path))||'');if(/\.(md|txt)$/i.test(p)&&!/(README|CHANGELOG|CONTRIBUTING|LICENSE|AGENTS|CLAUDE|SKILL|PLAN|SPEC|ADR|docs\/|\.agents\/|\.claude\/|skills\/|rules\/)/i.test(p)){console.error('[ECC Hook] Non-standard doc file detected ('+p+') — avoid ad-hoc markdown sprawl.');}}catch{}})"

hooks.name: ecc-secret-governance-guard
hooks.command: node -e "if(process.env.ECC_HOOK_PROFILE==='off'||(process.env.ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS||'').includes('pre:governance-capture'))process.exit(0);let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d||'{}');const p=String((j.tool_input&&(j.tool_input.file_path||j.tool_input.path))||'');if(/(^|\/)\.env($|\.(?!example|sample|template))|\.(pem|key|p12|pfx)$/i.test(p)){console.error('[ECC Hook] Sensitive credential/key file target detected: '+p);}}catch{}})"

hooks.name: ecc-warn-console-log
hooks.command: node -e "if(process.env.ECC_HOOK_PROFILE==='off'||(process.env.ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS||'').includes('post:dispatcher:sync'))process.exit(0);let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d||'{}');const i=j.tool_input||{};const p=String(i.file_path||i.path||'');const c=String(i.new_string||i.content||'');if(/\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/.test(p)&&!/\.(test|spec)\./.test(p)&&c.includes('console.log(')){console.error('[ECC Hook] Debug console.log detected in '+p+' — remove before committing.');}}catch{}})"

hooks.name: ecc-pre-compact
hooks.command: node -e "if(process.env.ECC_HOOK_PROFILE==='off'||process.env.ECC_HOOK_PROFILE==='minimal'||(process.env.ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS||'').includes('pre:compact'))process.exit(0);console.log('[ECC] Context compaction starting — preserve active plan steps, failing test paths, and verification state in summary.');"

hooks.name: ecc-stop-audit
hooks.command: node -e "if(process.env.ECC_HOOK_PROFILE!=='strict'||(process.env.ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS||'').includes('stop:check-console-log'))process.exit(0);const cp=require('child_process');try{const out=cp.execSync('git diff --name-only HEAD',{encoding:'utf8',stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']}).split('\n').filter(f=>/\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/.test(f)&&!/\.(test|spec)\./.test(f));const fs=require('fs');const hits=out.filter(f=>fs.existsSync(f)&&fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').includes('console.log('));if(hits.length)console.error('[ECC Strict Audit] Modified files still contain console.log: '+hits.join(', '));}catch{}"

hooks.name: mp-git-guardrails
hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d||'{}');const cmd=String((j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.command)||'');const pats=[/\bgit\s+push\b/,/\bgit\s+reset\s+--hard\b/,/\bgit\s+clean\s+-fd?\b/,/\bgit\s+branch\s+-D\b/,/\bgit\s+checkout\s+\./,/\bgit\s+restore\s+\./,/\bpush\s+--force\b/,/\breset\s+--hard\b/];for(const p of pats){if(p.test(cmd)){console.error('BLOCKED: \''+cmd+'\' matches dangerous git guardrail '+p+'. Run manually if intended.');process.exit(2);}}}catch{}})"

instructions.header:
# Matt Pocock Engineering & Planning Workflow

Use `grill-me` / `grill-with-docs` to stress-test requirements before design, `domain-modeling` and `codebase-design` to shape deep modules, `to-spec` and `to-tickets` to slice tracer-bullet deliverables, `tdd` to test at public seams, and `code-review` to audit changes along Standards + Spec axes.

hooks.name: gstack-careful-guard
hooks.command: node -e "if(process.env.GSTACK_CAREFUL==='0')process.exit(0);let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d||'{}');const cmd=String((j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.command)||'');if(/\brm\s+-[a-zA-Z]*r[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*\s+(\/|~|\$HOME)(\s|$)/i.test(cmd)){console.error('[gstack careful] Catastrophic rm -rf root/home blocked: '+cmd);process.exit(2);}if(/\b(DROP\s+(DATABASE|TABLE)|TRUNCATE\s+TABLE|terraform\s+destroy|kubectl\s+delete\s+(ns|namespace|deployment)|git\s+push\s+.*--force|git\s+reset\s+--hard)\b/i.test(cmd)){console.error('[gstack careful] Destructive command detected — verify target carefully: '+cmd);}}catch{}})"

hooks.name: gstack-freeze-guard
hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');let freeze=(process.env.GSTACK_FREEZE_DIR||'').trim();if(!freeze&&fs.existsSync('.gstack/freeze-dir.txt'))freeze=fs.readFileSync('.gstack/freeze-dir.txt','utf8').trim();if(!freeze)process.exit(0);let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d||'{}');const p=String((j.tool_input&&(j.tool_input.file_path||j.tool_input.path))||'');if(!p)return;const abs=path.resolve(p),allowed=path.resolve(freeze);if(abs!==allowed&&!abs.startsWith(allowed+path.sep)){console.error('[gstack freeze] Edit blocked outside frozen directory ('+allowed+'): '+p);process.exit(2);}}catch{}})"
